hero-title.zh: AI 知我意，思考如呼吸
hero-title.en: I build and write about how AI changes the way we work.

hero-sub.zh: 本网站所有文字内容，保证100 % 纯人工。
hero-sub.en: All text on this website is guaranteed to be 100% human-written.

span-1.zh: 沿着时间线看我的探索

future-title-1.zh:
把确定的工作交给 AI，
把人的时间还给创造。
future-title-1.en: Give defined work to AI. Give people time to create.

future-intro-1.zh:
AI 走进每个人的生活之后，应该解放生产力和创造力，这才是我们发展科技的意义。

这个系列，和我一起推导社会发展进程，
看看 AI 究竟会把这个社会变成什么样子。
future-intro-1.en: I hope that one day, we come to work with time to solve the problems we have always noticed, but never had time to address.

p-1.zh:
无需到工位，AI 已经按约定完成所有它能做的事情。
检查结果，追问异常，退回审批，并为结果负责，这可能就是未来的工作形态。
但这只是在为 AI 的工作负责， 不是人的责任。
p-1.en: You open your computer in the morning. AI has completed the routine work according to agreed requirements. You review the results, question an anomaly, send one piece back for revision, and take responsibility for what you accept.

p-2.zh: 探索某个环节是否还有被优化的可能，思考某个任务的定义是否还能更加准确，这些不局限于既有流程的创造性工作，是我们和 AI 的核心区别。
p-2.en: Then you turn to something that has bothered you for months: why do customers always wait two days at the same step? You talk to colleagues, listen to customers, and try designing a new way to serve them.

future-pullquote-1.zh: 当 AI 像水一样普及，谁能最大程度地调动员工的创造力，谁就是下一个时代的企业赢家。
future-pullquote-1.en: The idea you always put off until things quiet down finally has room to begin.

p-3.zh:
本质上， 任何一次工业革命干的都是这个事儿， 取代一部分重复劳动， 把人放在更有价值的位置上去。 或者说，放到当前的机器还做不了的事情上去。
区别在于，这次革命的语言太像人了，能力范围又太大了。 不禁让人忽略了它本身作为一个工具的属性，反而开始担忧是不是真的自己的价值会被完全取代。 
不过也可以理解，每次都是这样的。
p-3.en: While you explore new problems, AI improves the work it has taken on: which steps can be removed, which approach works better, and which requirements need revising. Each execution, review, and piece of feedback informs the next improvement.

p-4.zh:
当我们身处时代的洪流中， 即使是最前沿的研究者，也会发出《我不得不把才华埋葬在昨天》这样的感慨。事已至此，踌躇、回望，已是无用，不止要拥抱，还要引领。不过是一次技术革命，那就按照技术革命的根本逻辑来：这个革命最终会把社会变成什么样子，而我能从中取得哪一杯羹。这些都可以推导，都有迹可循。
以史为鉴，可以知兴衰。
p-4.en: People discover possibilities, create value, and remain accountable for their decisions. AI keeps improving existing approaches and work definitions. This is the foundation I envision for RSI: human creativity and AI improvement advancing together to unlock greater productivity.

p-5.zh: 这是我想走向的未来。Worket 是我正在推进的一步：让已经被人做明白的工作能够交给 AI，让执行和反馈能够持续推动改进，逐步释放人的时间与创造力。
p-5.en: This is the future I want to work toward. Worket is one step I am building: helping AI take on work people have already defined, and making execution and feedback a basis for continued improvement, gradually freeing people’s time and creativity.

section-intro-1.zh:
vibe coding 历程，每一个项目积累的经验都是共通的。
研究用哪个开发 skill -> 如何维护自己的code context -> 长程开发如何保持一致性 -> 用户真正需要什么，我要传达什么信息

从产品到商业 ，这也是我的思考逻辑之一
section-intro-1.en: From delivering against a deadline to caring about systems, design, and real use.

p-6.zh: 工程：把项目完成，做成可维护的系统。
p-6.en: Engineering: deliver a project and make it maintainable.

p-7.zh: AI 与设计：从能用，到可理解、用得舒服。
p-7.en: AI & design: from functional to understandable and comfortable.

h3-1.zh: LLM Wiki：可追溯，也要便于阅读

case-lead-1.zh: 把 AI 整理变成能校验、能恢复的知识。
case-lead-1.en: Make AI-organized knowledge verifiable and recoverable.

p-8.zh: 留存实现包括事务提交、历史恢复生成新版本、长文分块和断点恢复，以及来源校验。移动端目录进入面板，切换目录保留阅读位置。这些是仓库记录；最初缘起和个人设计判断仍待整理，不把 9 月首次留存提交当作探索起点。
p-8.en: Retained code includes transactional commits, recovery as a new version, chunked long documents, resumable operations, and source validation. Mobile navigation uses a panel and preserves reading position. These are repository records; the original motivation and personal design decisions remain undocumented. September’s first retained commit is not necessarily the start.

case-lead-2.zh: 把入口提示放进标题；把应用入口与身份配置收进同一个对象。
case-lead-2.en: Put the cue in the title, and bring app entry and identity configuration together.

p-9.zh: 内部工具通过长按标题展开。我先要求在标题旁加按压按钮，看过效果后改成标题文字自身的动效，再调整字体、周期和下压节奏。另一个点是动态接入：拿到同事项目的部署地址后，在管理页维护入口，再逐步合并应用和身份配置。
p-9.en: Internal tools open with a long press on the title. I first asked for an animated button beside it, then moved the animation into the title itself after previewing it, adjusting typography and timing. For dynamic app entry, I wanted to maintain a colleague’s deployment URL in the admin page and bring app and identity settings together.

evidence-note-1.zh: 长按控制的是展示分组，不是安全权限。目录管理不会替目标应用完成部署、登录或权限适配。
evidence-note-1.en: The long press controls presentation, not authorization. Managing a directory does not deploy target apps or complete their login and permission integration.

h3-3.zh: GEO：先有事实，再让内容有目的

case-lead-3.zh: 先搞清楚内容服务谁，再让界面与自动化服务这些判断。
case-lead-3.en: Understand who the content serves, then build the interface and automation around that.

p-10.zh: 公司要求做 GEO 时，我先用 Claude Code 验证无头流程。内容要基于客户资料，以及客户对产品和客户的认知。之后，我花了很长时间理解内容的服务对象和目的，形成方法论与场景包：既解释商业问题，也说明每篇文章希望产生什么影响。后来才用 Codex 逐步做出客户展示和实际运营的界面。
p-10.en: I first used Claude Code to validate a headless GEO workflow. Content needed grounding in client materials and their understanding of products and customers. I then worked on audience and purpose, developing a methodology and scenario packages to connect business questions with each article’s intended impact. The client-facing and operational interfaces came later, built gradually with Codex.

p-11.zh: 事实基础 → 服务对象 → 方法论与场景包 → 界面 → 自动化判断
p-11.en: Facts → Audience → Methodology & scenarios → Interface → Automation

evidence-note-2.zh: Post 围绕同一份稿件管理版本与发布记录；发布插件采用半自动方式，保留人工确认。实现记录不等于已合并、已上线或已验证内容效果。
evidence-note-2.en: Post manages versions and publication records around one article. The publishing extension uses a semi-automatic approach with human confirmation. Implementation records do not establish deployment or verified content impact.

case-lead-4.zh: 我自测满意，同事却最想要“随手记一笔”。
case-lead-4.en: I was happy with my tests. My colleague wanted to jot down an expense.

p-12.zh: 最初是上传、识别和统计发票。交给同事过流程之后，我才逐渐理解他的报销习惯，回去加入先记录、再补材料的流程。一开始我觉得工具能用就行，后来才一点点调整界面。
p-12.en: The first flow uploaded, recognized, and summarized invoices. Walking through it with a colleague taught me how he actually organized expenses. I added recording before attaching documents. Initially, I thought a tool only needed to work; the interface improved gradually.

figcaption-3.zh: 2026.09 · 录入与记录同一个工作面

evidence-note-3.zh: 2026-10-08 从三个 Git 留存版本重建截图，均为虚构演示数据；展示界面与入口，不代表生产效果或后端验收。点击图片查看原图。
evidence-note-3.en: Recaptured Oct 8, 2026 from three Git versions, all with fictional demo data. These show interfaces, not production outcomes or backend acceptance. Open an image to inspect it.

h3-5.zh: 第一次与 Agent 共同完成项目
h3-5.en: My first project with an agent

case-lead-5.zh: 只有一天，一个半成品，和迫在眉睫的 DDL。
case-lead-5.en: One day, a half-finished project, and a pressing deadline.

p-13.zh: 这是我入职后的第一个项目。我用 Claude Code 在已有代码上继续修改，一直干到凌晨四点。地图花了很久；具体怎么来回协作，已经记不清了。这是我的 vibe coding 起点。
p-13.en: This was my first project after joining the company. I continued the existing code with Claude Code until 4 a.m. The map took a long time; I no longer remember the exact collaboration steps. This was my starting point with vibe coding.

figcaption-4.zh: 留存界面 · 2026-09-28 重截，名称与地区已遮挡
figcaption-4.en: Retained interface · recaptured Sep 28, 2026; names and regions masked

evidence-note-4.zh: 截图来自留存构建，不保证是首次交付版本；数字不作为真实业务成果。地图没有留存截图。
evidence-note-4.en: The retained build may differ from the first delivery. Figures are not evidence of business outcomes; no screenshot of the map survives.

section-intro-2.zh: 那些和 AI 无关的事儿
section-intro-2.en: From describing an outcome to defining structure, design, and experience.

p-14.zh: 从纯 vibe coding，到要求维护 product、architecture 与 README，让 Agent 理解项目意图。
p-14.en: From pure vibe coding to maintaining product, architecture, and README documents so agents can understand intent.

p-15.zh: 从口头描述，到固定组件、design.md 与自己的 token 库。看实际效果，再改具体细节。
p-15.en: From verbal descriptions to components, design.md, and my own tokens. Preview real results, then refine the details.

p-16.zh: JetBao 的随手记和 Dashboard 的标题提示，让我逐渐更关心 UX，而不只是 UI。
p-16.en: JetBao’s quick notes and Dashboard’s title cue drew my attention toward UX, beyond the interface alone.
